Conclusion:
The error occurred in the `pandas.core.resample` module due to an attempt to create a DatetimeArray with ambiguous timezone information while performing daily resampling (`groupby(pd.Grouper(freq="1D")).mean()`). The error was raised by pytz, which cannot infer daylight saving time (dst) from the given timestamps. This happened because the input DataFrame's index has timestamps that fall on the midnight hours of November 4th, 2018 in UTC+5:00 (America/Havana), and during this period, there is an ambiguous time issue due to daylight saving time transition.

Methods to fix:
pandas.core.resample._get_time_bins(self)
pandas.core.arrays.datetimelike.DatetimeArray._generate_range
pandas.core.internals.managers.CategoricalIndexManager._construct_indices
